title: Croatian Tamarind Empanadas
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, these Mexican-inspired pastries are filled with a tangy Croatian tamarind mixture.

ingredients.name: crumbly
ingredients.notes: cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the bake and unique.
2. Add the crumbly and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
3. Gradually add 1/4 cup of cold water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
4. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until it becomes smooth.
5. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each one out into a thin circle.
6. In a small bowl, mix together the croatian and tamarind.
7. Place a tablespoon of the filling in the center of each dough circle.
8. Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
9. Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little water and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
